name: cyber-incense
description: A playful local desktop ritual toy for developers.
author: Cyber Incense Contributors

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run generate:icons && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run generate:icons && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:ci: npm run generate:icons && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run generate:icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run generate:icons && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --publish never
